Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.feed

Class FeedHarvestScheduler

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.feed.FeedHarvestScheduler
@Component public class FeedHarvestScheduler extends Object
Scheduled driver that triggers RomeFeedHarvester at tier-appropriate cadences, filters harvested articles by tier, and persists them via ArticleStoragePort.

Tier cadences (configurable via application.yml):

  • ACADEMIC + REGULATORY – daily via harvestDailyFeeds()
  • INDUSTRY – every N ms via harvestIndustryFeeds()

Duplicate articles are silently skipped by ArticleStoragePort.save(java.util.List<com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.model.NewsArticle>) (dedup by URL), so repeated scheduler invocations are safe.

Every harvested NewsArticle carries a topicId propagated from its FeedSourceConfig. Downstream processing in Slice 2b will use this to scope AI summarization and vector embeddings to the correct Topic.
